verdict.rationale: New Relic documents NRQL, a SQL-like query language for its data, for answering specific troubleshooting or business-analysis questions and building charts and alerts. NerdGraph (with an API explorer) and the MCP server's natural-language-to-NRQL conversion add further ways to run ad hoc queries. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of NRQL ad hoc analysis, and evidence of in-depth syntax/function reference coverage beyond the introductory page.
